cards.title: Background Tasks
paragraphs: You can define background tasks to be run after returning a response.
As connecting to an email server and sending an email tends to be "slow" (several seconds), you can return the response right away and send the email notification in the background.
cards.question: Can I send an email after the response has been returned?
cards.quote: you can return the response right away and send the email notification in the background

cards.title: Behind a Proxy
paragraphs: In many situations, you would use a proxy like Traefik or Nginx in front of your FastAPI app.
But for security, as the server doesn't know it is behind a trusted proxy, it won't interpret those headers.
cards.question: Why does my app ignore the proxy's forwarded headers?
cards.quote: as the server doesn't know it is behind a trusted proxy, it won't interpret those headers

cards.title: Handling Errors
paragraphs: There are many situations in which you need to report an error to a client that is using your API.
In these cases, you would normally return an HTTP status code in the range of 400 (from 400 to 499).
cards.question: Which range of HTTP status codes means the client made an error?
cards.quote: return an HTTP status code in the range of 400 (from 400 to 499)
